data.body:
make verify on patch set 2's tree: lint and typecheck green, pytest 19747 passed, 17 failed. The 17 are exactly the known arm64 pandoc host-defect set (rebar_reconciler wiki-render, rich-text, and diff-comments). Patch set 2 (4f483d78b2e) was pushed, then superseded within minutes by patch set 3 (9415967b513). Patch set 3 corrects 2 doc claims that were unconditional and that patch set 2's test change made inaccurate on Python 3.13+:
- ADR 0119's consequences bullet now says the golden is byte-for-byte on 3.11/3.12 and compared after `inspect.cleandoc` on 3.13+.
- The release-notes entry now says nothing changes on 3.11/3.12. The deployed server image `infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp` is `python:3.12-slim`. On 3.13+ the derived tools' multi-line descriptions keep their 3.12 continuation-line indentation (whitespace only).

Both files are already in file_impact (still 21 paths, equal to the diff). The patch set 3 delta is prose only and was checked with these:
- the pre-commit lint and typecheck
- `check_adr_numbers.py` and `gen_adr_index.py --check`
- the 23 test modules that reference the release notes or ADRs: 484 passed; the 13 failures are all in the pandoc set

make verify was not re-run on patch set 3.
